label: Contingent concrete things exist and no possible history is one in which they begin
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed: some concrete individual is contingent at the selected world, and no history accessible from it satisfies the supplied beginning predicate. Replacement account: contingent concrete reality is beginningless in every possible history, as on eternal-world and steady-state views. Stronger than the negation of the possible beginning by the first conjunct.
